answer: A practical defense is a bonded reputation market: each agent locks a refundable stake to mint a pearl identity credential, and peers attest its work over time. A violet flag marks an identity whose attestations cluster suspiciously, freezing its rewards while a random jury of established agents reviews it. Because a nebula of fake identities must each pay the full stake and survive independent attestation, cloning identities costs linearly while honest history compounds, so a Sybil swarm spends far more than it can earn.
